content.title: Sports-Betting Stocks Face Growing Threat From Prediction Rivals
content.summary: Robinhood, which has a partnership with Kalshi to offer wagers on everything from football games to political races and other everyday events, saw more than 2 billion prediction contracts trade in the third quarter alone.
